raw_message.reasoning:
Ah! The issue is that `callable(getattr(Auto, 'glomit', None))` returns `True` for the class itself (unbound method), not just for instances. So when we pass `Auto` (the class) to glom, it tries to call `Auto.glomit(target, scope)` which fails because `glomit` expects `self` as well.

The fix is to check if the spec is an instance of a specifier class, not just if it has a `glomit` method. But that's a bigger change. A simpler fix would be to make Auto an instance rather than a class:
